Name: Sodi Transformation - Content Patcher
Author: MartinePol
Description:
[u][b][size=4]You have the full right to edit or reupload a new version as long as you credit me proberly.[/size][/b][/u]

This mod currently changes Sam's Sprites and Portraits through reaching certain Heart stages to resemble more and more like Jodi.

Sam is changing at the first event, 6-8, 9-11 and 12- 14 hearts [May change over the development].

! If there are any problems with the mod like not working or having other issues. Please tell me with a few information on what version or device you used it. !

[b]Currently:[/b]
- Sprite change in 4 Stages for normal and beach.
- Portraits change in 4 Stages for normal and beach.
- 14 lines of Dialogue (will be expanded over time)
- Added certain Items (currently added 1).
- Added events (currently 1 / 4?)

[b]Plan:[/b]
- Adding Festival versions

I hope you have fun with this mod. I am sorry if it's currently not so much, but I try my best to update it as often as I can.
If you have any thoughts on this mod. Pls tell me.

I am happy to know everyones thought about it either through comments or videos.

If you want to use the editied assets for yourself you can do this just credit me and write maybe a comment on what you used so I can maybe check it out too.

Downloads.Description:
- first event to trigger at 20 - 22 with 2 Hearts at Jodi. (sorry if you think it's cringy, I tried my best writing it.)
- Sam's Portrait now changes after watching the first event, rather than hearts for the rest still the same.
